# uptimekuma_notification_amootsms (Resource)

Amoot SMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send a plain SMS. line_number "public" is the value the Uptime Kuma web UI suggests.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_amootsms" "example" {
  name        = "Amoot SMS Notifications"
  api_token   = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  mobiles     = "09120000000,09120000001"
  line_number = "public"
  is_default  = false
}

# Send the message as the values of a pattern registered with Amoot SMS.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_amootsms" "pattern" {
  name            = "Amoot SMS Pattern"
  api_token       = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  mobiles         = "09120000000"
  use_pattern     = true
  pattern_code_id = 1234
}

# Send pattern messages from your own line.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_amootsms" "pattern_own_line" {
  name            = "Amoot SMS Pattern Own Line"
  api_token       = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  mobiles         = "09120000000"
  use_pattern     = true
  pattern_code_id = 1234
  use_own_line    = true
  line_number     = "50001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mobiles` (String) The comma-separated recipient numbers. Uptime Kuma trims every entry and drops empty ones.
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The Amoot SMS API token. Stored in state; use `api_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The Amoot SMS API token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_token`; requires `api_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_token` until the next apply with `api_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_token_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Attach this notification to all existing monitors. This is a one-time action: it runs when the notification is created with `true`, or when the value changes from `false` to `true`. Other updates do not attach it again, so monitors detached from the notification later stay detached. Uptime Kuma does not store the value, so the provider keeps it from the configuration. An imported notification starts with `false`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `line_number` (String) The sender line, for example `public`, the value the Uptime Kuma web UI suggests. Required unless `use_pattern` is `true`. With `use_pattern`, required when `use_own_line` is `true` and ignored otherwise.
- `pattern_code_id` (Number) The ID of the pattern registered with Amoot SMS. Required when `use_pattern` is `true`, ignored otherwise.
- `use_own_line` (Boolean) Send pattern messages from `line_number`. Only used when `use_pattern` is `true`.
- `use_pattern` (Boolean) Send the message as the values of a pattern registered with Amoot SMS instead of as plain text. Requires `pattern_code_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
